content.text: I will create an executable script ~/count_exp.sh that counts regular files and directories inside ~/exp_folder (excluding the top-level folder itself) and outputs their sum, then show the script content.

arguments:
{"script":"cat > ~/count_exp.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Count regular files and directories inside $HOME/exp_folder (including subdirs).
# Directories count excludes the top-level exp_folder itself.
TARGET="$HOME/exp_folder"
if [ ! -d "$TARGET" ]; then
  echo "0"
  exit 0
fi
files=$(find "$TARGET" -type f | wc -l)
dirs=$(find "$TARGET" -mindepth 1 -type d | wc -l)
sum=$((files + dirs))
echo "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x ~/count_exp.sh
echo "Created ~/count_exp.sh"
sed -n '1,200p' ~/count_exp.sh
"}
